sheets.promptOrBrief: Create one clean, internally consistent Milo episode model sheet in a soft layered 2D/2.5D children's storybook treatment. Show front, three-quarter, profile, and back views at one stable relative scale. Preserve every source-supported appearance trait exactly. Use an upright, hand-capable episode production model, a gentle small-step bipedal stance, and a rounded compact mustard-yellow two-strap backpack. Keep the treatment warm, safe, simple, and suitable for selective animation. No text beyond neutral view labels, no new accessories, no absolute height, no new powers, and no claim that episode proportions or geometry are canon.
